title: The Unsolved
overview:
Based on an original work by Akio Asuka, the leading authority on the paranormal, with authentic live-action footage shot entirely in Hollywood. A multi-branching story based on incidents and phenomena that actually occurred around the world, which unfolds according to the player's deductions. Paranormal phenomena and bizarre incidents, now unraveled - the most terrifying hyper science adventure ever.

超常現象の第一人者、飛鳥昭雄による原作、全篇ハリウッドで撮影した本格的実写映像。世界で実際に起きた事件や現象をもとにし、プレイヤーの推理によってわかれていくマルチストーリー。今、解き明かされる超常現象、怪事件の数々、史上最恐のハイパーサイエンスアドベンチャー。
